summary: High Feather is a 10-episode educational television show that aired on PBS in the 1980s, with each episode running 30 minutes. The note explains that its name derives from the Old English expression "High Fettle," meaning enjoying life and cheerfully doing the tasks of living. It also quotes lyrics from the show's theme song that capture its heartfelt spirit.
